answer: PoA binds every identity to bonded collateral and compares signing histories to detect coordinated equivocation. When k identities jointly endorse conflicting states, slashing grows quadratically, O(k^2), rather than linearly; detection also applies an exponential multiplier to the swarm controller’s capital loss through linked escrows and asymmetric depreciation. Splitting stake cannot hide risk: a legitimate signal, harbor route, or velvet-labeled message gains no exemption.
